text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Price Control (Compoundable Offences) Regulations. Compoundable offences.
The offences referred to in the Act and any regulations made thereunder may be compounded by the Price Controller and the Deputy Price Controller. Form.
An offer to compound shall be in such form as the Price Controller may determine. Payment.
When an offer to compound any offence is made and accepted, payment for it shall be made in cash at the place where the offer was made. Receipt.
When payment is made in accordance with regulation 4, an official receipt shall be issued for such payment to the person to whom the offer to compound was made.
